### Where do I find my Puzzle Jar version number?

At the bottom of Settings. Open Settings from the Home screen and you'll see "Puzzle Jar" followed by the version number, above the "Done" button. Please include it when you write to us about a problem, because fixes often arrive in a specific version.

### How do I reset my progress in Puzzle Jar?

There is no reset button in the app. The only way to start over is to delete Puzzle Jar and install it again, which clears all progress, streaks and unused helpers. Remove Ads and other one-time purchases come back with Restore purchases; hint, take back and rescue packs do not. If you only want to replay a game, Free play and the daily puzzles may do instead.

### How do I leave a review for Puzzle Jar?

On the store page. On iPhone, open Puzzle Jar's App Store page , scroll to Ratings & Reviews and tap the option to write a review. On Android, open the Google Play page and tap a star under "Rate this app". Honest reviews, good or bad, help other players and tell us what to fix.

### How do I contact Puzzle Jar support?

Email us at sultanofniyyat@gmail.com. We are a small studio and read every message ourselves. To get a useful answer faster, include your phone model, its iOS or Android version, the Puzzle Jar version from the bottom of Settings, which game and level, and what happened. A screenshot helps a lot.

### I played Route Duel. What happened to my levels?

They're still yours. Route Duel became Puzzle Jar in the 2.0.0 update on the same store page, so updating kept your Route Duel levels, Remove Ads and other purchases. Hints and take backs you had saved were moved into Puzzle Jar's shared counts, and every player also got the welcome gift on top.

### Where is Route Duel now?

Inside Puzzle Jar, as one of its 20 games. Open Free play on the Home screen and tap Route Duel to carry on your duels against the computer rival, or play Solo Run from the same card. On the level road, Route Duel comes last in each lap of the 20 games. Its own page explains the rules.

### Does Puzzle Jar send notifications?

No. Puzzle Jar doesn't send push notifications or reminders, and it never asks for permission to. You won't get "your lives are full" or "come back" messages. Anything the app has to tell you, such as the ad warning card or the Starter Pack offer, appears only while you have it open.

## The best puzzle games for your situation

URL: https://sultanofniyyat.github.io/puzzle-jar/best-puzzle-games/

The best puzzle game depends on what you need: offline play, no timer, no ads, something calm, or something for a long trip. For each need below we give one to three honest picks, from other studios and from our own app, Puzzle Jar, and say where Puzzle Jar is not the right choice (no iPad version, no word or number games, ads unless you buy Remove Ads). Facts about other games come from their official store pages, checked on 2026-11-24.

### What are the best offline puzzle games for iPhone?

Pick games that store every level inside the app. Puzzle Jar does: all 20 games and the daily puzzles play in airplane mode, and it runs on iOS 15 or newer. Paid one-off games such as Monument Valley and Monument Valley 2 (ustwo games) are another route, and Apple Arcade says its games have no ads. For any game that is not ours, open it once in airplane mode at home before you count on it offline. Our offline page explains exactly what in Puzzle Jar still needs internet.

### What are the best offline puzzle games for Android?

On Android, Simon Tatham's Puzzles, ported by Chris Boyle, is a standout: free, open source, and its Google Play page shows no ads label and no purchases label. It holds 40 classic logic puzzles. If you prefer bright color-and-shape games, Puzzle Jar works offline on Android 7.0 or newer, with screw, sort, tile, bus and bubble games in one download. Mini Metro by Dinosaur Polo Club is a paid strategy-puzzle choice with no ads or purchases label on Google Play. We have not tested other studios' games offline, so open them once in airplane mode before relying on them.

### What are the best puzzle games for adults?

Adults usually want depth without childish rewards or pressure. Our picks: Quilt Pins for pure logic (one answer per grid, solved by reasoning), Bolts & Jars for planning a few moves ahead, and, from other studios, Monument Valley for a beautiful paid puzzle story. Simon Tatham's Puzzles suits people who like pencil-and-paper logic. Puzzle Jar was made with adults in mind: no story, no characters to dress, just puzzles that grow harder in steady rounds.

### What are the best puzzle games for seniors?

Good choices are unhurried, readable and forgiving. In Puzzle Jar, start with Sweet Stacks , where undo and restart are always free, or Button Tin , which has no move limit; colors also carry symbols, which helps tired eyes. Honest limits: there is no large-text setting, the app is English only, and on Apple devices it runs on iPhone, not iPad. Many older players also like jigsaws; Apple Arcade lists "Jigsaw Puzzle by MobilityWare+" for subscribers.

### What are good brain games for seniors?

Choose games that are enjoyable and social rather than ones that promise to protect memory, because no game has proved that. The Alzheimer's Society says there is "no strong evidence" that brain training lowers dementia risk ( Alzheimer's Society ). For variety, a collection helps: Puzzle Jar switches games every three levels, and Simon Tatham's Puzzles has 40 logic types. Word and number fans will be happier with crosswords or sudoku, which we do not make. The research is summed up on our puzzle types page .

### What are the best puzzle games for kids?

For young children, games without ads or purchases are the safest pick, such as subscription services built for families; Apple Arcade states its games have no ads or in-app purchases ( Apple ). Puzzle Jar is made for a general audience, not specially for children, and it shows ads and sells helpers. Read our kids, safety and privacy page before handing it to a child; it explains ratings and how to lock purchases.

### What is the best game for a long flight?

Bring a mix: one game you can sink hours into and one you can drop the moment the meal cart arrives, all downloaded and opened once before you fly. A longer paid puzzle adventure suits a quiet few hours, if you have checked it starts in airplane mode. A collection like Puzzle Jar gives variety from one download, and its levels are short enough to stop mid-descent. Charge your phone, pack headphones, and avoid games that need a connection to start; airline wifi is unreliable and often paid.

### What are the most relaxing puzzle games?

The calmest games share three traits: no clock, no lives to wait for, and no punishment for thinking slowly. In Puzzle Jar, Sweet Stacks , Shelf Sort and Snug Skeins fit that best. From other studios, "stitch." on Apple Arcade (Lykkegaard) is a gentle embroidery puzzle, and A Little to the Left (Secret Mode) is a tidying game you can try free before unlocking the full game. Turn off music if even soft sound distracts you.

### What are the best cozy puzzle games for iPhone?

Cozy usually means soft art, homely themes and no failure stress. Unpacking (Witch Beam, paid, with Unpacking+ on Apple Arcade) is a favorite: you unbox a life into new rooms. Patterned on Apple Arcade is a relaxed pattern puzzle whose page says "No ads. No in-app purchases." In Puzzle Jar, the coziest are Snug Skeins , with woolly felt toys, and Honey Hive , with honey tiles on a comb. Ours is cozy in looks; it still has ads between levels unless removed.

### What are the best puzzle games with no timer?

Most of Puzzle Jar qualifies: 19 of its 20 games show no clock, and the only countdown is Route Duel's optional Solo Run. Eight of our games also have no move limit at all, so you can only lose by filling the space: Bolts & Jars, Sweet Stacks, Button Tin, Nut Sort, Hop On, Snug Skeins, Shelf Sort and Honey Hive. Outside our app, pencil-and-paper style logic collections such as Simon Tatham's Puzzles are a natural fit. Avoid "rush" or "challenge" modes, which often add one.

### Which sorting games have no timer?

In Puzzle Jar every sorting game plays without a clock: Nut Sort , Sweet Stacks , Shelf Sort , Snug Skeins and the screw game Bolts & Jars. None counts your moves either; you only get stuck when every free space fills. Shelf Sort even waits for you: after 40 moves without a pop it offers help or a "KEEP TRYING" button, nothing more. Some popular sorting games elsewhere add timed levels, so read the store description first.

### Which puzzle games have no lives?

Puzzle Jar has no lives or energy anywhere, so a lost level can be retried instantly, as often as you want. That includes Bead Swap, Fruit Tumble and our other level-based games, which in many apps come with lives. A few of our games use hearts inside a level, such as 3 hearts in Quilt Pins and Pencil Case, but losing them only ends that try. If lives are what you dislike elsewhere, read a game's store description for "lives" or "energy" before installing.

### What are the best puzzle games without ads?

For truly ad-free play, pay once or subscribe. Apple Arcade says its games come with "no ads" and no in-app purchases ( Apple ); Netflix says the same of its games ( Netflix Help ). Paid apps such as Mini Metro and Monument Valley 2 show no ads label on Google Play. Free and ad-free: Simon Tatham's Puzzles. Puzzle Jar is free with ads between levels; a one-time Remove Ads purchase ends the full-screen ones in all 20 games.

### What are the best sorting games without ads?

On iPhone, Apple Arcade lists "Water Sort Puzzle: Get Color+" from Tripledot Studios, an ad-free color sort for subscribers. On Android there is no Arcade, so check each game's store page for the "Contains ads" label. Puzzle Jar's five sorting games (Nut Sort, Sweet Stacks, Shelf Sort, Snug Skeins and Bolts & Jars) are free with ads, and one Remove Ads purchase covers all of them, so you do not pay per game. See what Remove Ads does .

### What are the best sorting games for adults?

Adults tend to want sorting with real decisions, not just obvious moves. Our picks from Puzzle Jar: Nut Sort , where bolts of different heights and hidden dark nuts force planning, and Shelf Sort , where goods hidden behind the front row change what is safe. For a classic, Water Sort Puzzle by IEC Global is the long-standing liquid version. Every third level is a hard one and every fourth hard level is a boss, so the challenge keeps returning.

### What is the best screw puzzle game?

Screw Jam by Rollic Games is the name most people know, free on iPhone and Android. Many copies share the screw-puzzle name, so look at the developer before installing. Our own, Bolts & Jars , is a strong pick if you dislike rushing: no clock, no move limit, a 5-hole tray, and every level checked by a solver as winnable without help. It comes with 19 other games in the same download, which matters if you tire of one genre.

### What is the best nuts and bolts game?

If you mean the color-sorting kind, the big names include Tripledot's "Nut Sort: Color Sorting Game". Our Nut Sort mixes in tall and short bolts in changing board shapes from level 7, and dark nuts on hard levels. If you mean screws in plates, that is a screw puzzle; try Bolts & Jars . And if you came for the snack mix of the same name, this page cannot help, sorry.

### What are the best tile matching games for adults?

Triple Tile (Tripledot Studios), Tile Busters (Spyke Games) and Zen Match (Moon Active) are the well-known three. In Puzzle Jar, Button Tin is our tile match, with piles growing to about 70-96 buttons and face-down buttons on later hard levels, which gives adults more to plan. It never limits moves; you lose only if the 7-space card fills with no three alike. People who prefer classic pairs matching may like a mahjong solitaire app better.

### What are the best offline match-3 games?

Look for games whose levels are built in, not streamed. Bead Swap in Puzzle Jar plays fully offline, with specials, wax, crates and gaps, on 7x7 to 9x9 trays. Royal Match (Dream Games) and Candy Crush Saga (King) are the famous free alternatives and very polished, but we have not tested them offline, so try them in airplane mode before a trip.

### What is the best bubble shooter game offline?

For offline play, our Bubble Picnic works with no signal and has no lives and no lowering ceiling, with a dotted aim guide that shows bounces. The classic free names are Bubble Witch 3 Saga by King and the "Bubble Shooter" apps by Ilyon, both free to download with ads and purchases according to their Google Play pages. If you want a bubble shooter on an iPad, choose one of those, since Puzzle Jar has no iPad version.

### What are the best block puzzle games?

For endless, score-chasing play, Block Blast! by Hungry Studio is the obvious one, and it has an ad-free "Block Blast!+" on Apple Arcade. The official Tetris app from PlayStudios is the pick for falling blocks. For levels with a goal, Mosaic Tray in Puzzle Jar deals a fixed, limited set of pieces so each level has a planned solution, and you free jewels instead of chasing a score. Those who want blocks that slide out of a box should try Toy Chest .

### What are the best logic puzzle games for phone?

Logic fans have good free options. Simon Tatham's Puzzles collects 40 classic logic types, free and open source, with ports on Android and iPhone ( Simon Tatham ). LinkedIn's daily games include Queens and Tango. Our Quilt Pins is a Star Battle-type grid with a bank of 2,000 quilts, harder steps at set levels, and a hint that explains why a pin must go where it does. If you love sudoku, Apple Arcade has "Good Sudoku+".

### What are good puzzle games for a two-minute break?

Pick games with short levels and no penalty for leaving mid-way. We built Honey Hive levels to last about two minutes, and early levels in every Puzzle Jar game are small. Garland Tangle levels are only 4 to 24 moves. A daily puzzle, like LinkedIn's or Puzzle Jar's "Today's puzzles", is another neat fit: one puzzle, done, back to work. Endless games are worse for breaks because there is no natural stopping point.

### What puzzle games can you play with one hand?

Tap games are easiest one-handed in portrait. Puzzle Jar runs in portrait only, and most of its games are single taps: Bolts & Jars, Button Tin, Hop On, Pencil Case, Snug Skeins and the three blast games, Fruit Tumble, Balloon Bunch and Tide Pool. Games that need a drag, such as Mosaic Tray, Honey Hive and Shelf Sort (which also accepts tap-then-tap), work one-handed too, just slower. On a large phone, use the phone's one-handed or reachability mode to bring the top of the screen down.

### What are good puzzle games for a phone with little storage?

A collection saves space compared with many single-game apps, because each app carries its own engine and files. Puzzle Jar fits 20 games in about 106 MB on iPhone. Simple logic collections like Simon Tatham's Puzzles, with plain graphics, are another light option. Before installing, check the size on the store page, and remember games can grow with updates. If storage is very tight, play web puzzles such as 2048 in the browser instead.

### Which apps have many puzzle games in one?

Puzzle Jar puts 20 games in one app, from screw and nut sorting to match-3, a bubble shooter and a logic grid, with one shared level road and shared hints. Simon Tatham's Puzzles has 40 logic puzzles in one free app. LinkedIn offers several daily puzzles in its app. One limit of ours: every game is a color-and-shape puzzle, with no word, card or number games among them.

### Are there free puzzle games with no in-app purchases?

Yes, but they are rare. Simon Tatham's Puzzles is free, open source and shows no ads or purchases labels on Google Play. LinkedIn says anyone, member or not, can play its daily puzzles. Puzzle Jar is not one of them: it is free to download and has in-app purchases (Remove Ads, hint packs, take backs, rescues and a one-time Starter Pack), though every level can be won without buying anything. Subscriptions like Apple Arcade avoid purchases inside games, but the subscription itself costs money.

### What are good games for anxiety and stress?

If you want a game to unwind, look for one with no clock, no lives and nothing to lose by stopping: Sweet Stacks and Shelf Sort fit, as do cozy titles like Unpacking. Research hints that a game hard enough to absorb you, but not too hard, helps most while waiting on worrying news ( UC Riverside, Tetris study ). Games are not a treatment. If anxiety is affecting your days, the NHS advises seeing a GP ( NHS ).

### What are the best brain training games?

We would pick games you enjoy over games that promise a sharper brain. A 2014 statement from the Stanford Center on Longevity said brain game claims "are frequently exaggerated and at times misleading" ( Stanford ). Logic puzzles like Quilt Pins or Simon Tatham's collection give real thinking work, and switching between different puzzle types keeps it fresh. Physical activity, hearing care and staying social are among the changeable dementia risks named by the 2024 Lancet Commission ( Livingston et al. ), which is stronger ground than any app.

### What are the best merge games offline?

Suika Game by Aladdin X is the famous drop-and-merge game, sold as a paid app, with "Suika Game+" on Apple Arcade; we have not tested it offline, so try airplane mode first. Treat Drop is the merge game in Puzzle Jar and works without a signal; it gives each level a goal and a fixed order of sweets, rather than one endless round. Board-style merge games that build a town or garden are a different genre and often expect a connection for events.

### What are the best bus jam games?

Bus Jam by Rollic Games and Bus Out are two well-known names on the stores. In Puzzle Jar, Hop On is our bus jam, built to be played slowly: no clock, the next buses always visible, and a bench that grows from 4 to 7 seats. New twists arrive one at a time, from planters at level 5 to big six-seat buses at level 65, so you learn each one before the next.

### What are the best hexa sort games?

Hexa Sort from Lion Studios Plus is the well-known name, and many hexagon stacking games share the idea. In Puzzle Jar, Honey Hive is our take, on combs of 12 to 21 cells with 4 to 7 colors. Its locked cells open only by collecting tiles, never by an ad, and its rescue sends bees to lift the most mixed-up stacks off the comb. If you like chain reactions, it is a good second hexa game to keep.

### What are the best rope untangle games?

Twisted Tangle and Tangle Master 3D, both by Rollic Games, are the big names in rope puzzles. The pure logic version is Untangle in Simon Tatham's free collection, which is just points and lines. Our Garland Tangle sits in between: strings of lights between lanterns on posts, a move count per level from 4 to 24, and no timer or lives. Searching "rope untangle game no ads"? Ours has ads between levels unless you buy Remove Ads.

### What are the best yarn sort games?

Wool and yarn puzzles are a recent genre; Knit Out (Rollic Games) and Yarn Fever (Brave HK) are two of the names on the stores. Our Snug Skeins is the yarn game in Puzzle Jar: felt toys unwind layer by layer into baskets of their colors, with a sewing tin of 4 to 7 spots for spare wool. Toys show their next color and how many layers are left, so you can plan instead of guessing.

### What are the best tap-to-blast games?

Toon Blast by Peak is the well-known one. Puzzle Jar has three tap-to-blast games with different physics, which is unusual in one app: Fruit Tumble (fruit falls), Balloon Bunch (balloons rise) and Tide Pool (rows push up as you tap). None of the three has lives or a clock: Fruit Tumble and Balloon Bunch give each level a set number of moves, and in Tide Pool the tide rises by taps, not seconds.

### What are the best puzzle games for iPad?

Not Puzzle Jar, honestly: we only make an iPhone version for Apple devices. For iPad, Monument Valley and Monument Valley 2 (ustwo games) use the big screen beautifully, Unpacking is listed for iPad, and Simon Tatham's Puzzles has an iPhone and iPad port. If you play on an Android tablet, our help page covers how Puzzle Jar behaves there.

### What are the best puzzle games with no words or numbers?

If you want to play without reading or counting, every game in Puzzle Jar works by color, shape and position; the rules card is the only text. That makes it good for people learning English or tired of word games. On the other hand, if words or numbers are exactly what you want, Puzzle Jar is the wrong app; look at LinkedIn's daily games or "Good Sudoku+".

### What is the best puzzle game app in 2026?

There is no single best one; it depends on whether you want one deep game or many light ones. For one game, Monument Valley 3 by ustwo games is a highly polished choice that you can try free before unlocking the full game. For variety without paying, Puzzle Jar gives 20 games and thousands of levels free, with ads unless removed. For no ads at all on iPhone, an Apple Arcade subscription covers many puzzle games. We are biased about ours, so try two or three and keep the one you open every day.

### What are good games to play on your phone when you're bored?

Pick something that is ready the moment you open it and lets you stop without losing anything. Puzzle games suit this better than most: no matches to wait for, no team to let down. In Puzzle Jar the Play button picks up the next level at once, and if you are tired of one game, Free play lets you jump to any of the 20. If you would rather have one long game to lose yourself in, a story puzzle such as Monument Valley 3 is a better fit than a collection of short levels.

### What are good road trip games with no wifi?

For passengers, offline single-player puzzle games are the safest choice, because mobile signal drops on long drives. Download everything at home and open each game once while you still have a connection. Puzzle Jar plays every game offline, and Route Duel's Solo Run is the only part with a clock, so nobody is rushed when the car hits a bumpy stretch. If someone gets car sick reading or looking down, short levels with breaks to look out of the window help more than a long session.

### Is there a screw, sort or tile puzzle game with no ads?

Yes, but usually you pay for it once or by subscription. Apple Arcade has sort and block games with no ads, such as "Water Sort Puzzle: Get Color+" and "Block Blast!+". Most free screw, nut, tile, yarn and goods sort games show ads and sell a remove-ads option per game. Puzzle Jar works the same way, with one difference: its one-time Remove Ads purchase covers all 20 of its games at once, from the screw puzzle to the yarn sort. Optional reward videos stay, but nothing plays unless you tap for it.

## Games like the puzzle games you already play

URL: https://sultanofniyyat.github.io/puzzle-jar/games-like-popular-puzzle-games/

If you enjoy a popular puzzle game, the same genre usually has other good games, and one app can hold several of them. Below, for each well-known game, we say what its fans tend to like, which of Puzzle Jar's 20 games plays in that style and how it differs, and one or two other games worth a look. Facts about other games were checked on their App Store or Google Play pages on 2026-11-24; we are not connected to any of them.

### Which Puzzle Jar game matches the game I already play?

Use this as a quick guide; each line has its own answer further down. Puzzle Jar has no word, number, card or connect-the-dots games, so those fans should look elsewhere. If you like… Try in Puzzle Jar Screw Jam and screw pin puzzles Bolts & Jars Nut sort, water sort, ball sort Nut Sort , Sweet Stacks Triple tile games Button Tin Royal Match, Candy Crush Bead Swap Toon Blast and blast games Fruit Tumble , Balloon Bunch Block Blast Mosaic Tray Bus Jam, Bus Out Hop On Hexa Sort Honey Hive Goods Sort Shelf Sort Yarn and wool games Snug Skeins Twisted Tangle, Tangle Master 3D Garland Tangle Suika (watermelon) game Treat Drop Bubble shooters Bubble Picnic LinkedIn Queens Quilt Pins Unblock Me, Parking Jam Toy Chest , Pencil Case

### Is Puzzle Jar connected to any of these games?

No. Puzzle Jar is made by a small independent studio, and we have no link with any studio or game named on this page. Our games are our own designs in well-known genres, with their own pieces, rules and levels; a nut sort or a bus jam is a genre, the way "crossword" is. We name other games here only so you can find something you will enjoy, and we stick to plain, checkable facts about them.

### What games are like Screw Jam?

Screw Jam, from Rollic Games, is one of the best-known screw puzzles, free on iPhone and Android. Fans of the genre like the slow, satisfying clear-out and the moment a whole layer drops away. Our Bolts & Jars plays in the same family: plates held by screws, jars that take three screws each, and a 5-hole tray for spares. Ours has no clock or move limit, and every screw color carries its own symbol. Many apps share the "screw puzzle" name, so check the developer before you install.

### What games are like Screw Jam without ads?

Honestly, a free screw puzzle with no ads at all is hard to find, because most are paid for by ads. In Puzzle Jar the ads come between levels, never during one, and a one-time Remove Ads purchase takes away the full-screen ones in all 20 games, including Bolts & Jars. If you want a phone with no ads anywhere, Apple Arcade is the cleaner route: Apple states its games come "without ads or in-app purchases" ( Apple ), though it is a paid subscription and its puzzle line-up changes.

### What games are like Nut Sort?

"Nut Sort" is used by many apps; the biggest include "Nut Sort: Color Sorting Game" by Tripledot Studios. People like the clink of nuts stacking and how a messy board turns tidy. Our game is also called Nut Sort , after the genre; it mixes bolt heights (tall ones hold 5, helper bolts 2 or 3) and, on harder levels, dark nuts whose color shows only when they reach the top. If you want the same idea without metal parts, Water Sort Puzzle by IEC Global is the classic liquid version.

### What games are like Water Sort Puzzle or Ball Sort?

Water Sort Puzzle (IEC Global) and Ball Sort Puzzle (HM Games) are the two famous names of the color sort genre: tidy containers of mixed colors into single-color ones. Sweet Stacks is our version with sweets in jars; undo and restart are always free in it, and harder levels add wrapped sweets that hide their color. On Apple Arcade there is "Water Sort Puzzle: Get Color+" from Tripledot Studios, for subscribers.

### What games are like Royal Match?

Royal Match by Dream Games is a match-3: swap neighboring pieces to make lines, clear goals within a move count, and restore a castle between levels. Bead Swap is our match-3, with needles, bursts and rainbow beads, wax and crates to clear and brass buttons to bring down. It has no castle or story, and the beads that drop in are fixed for each level. For another big match-3 with a story, Candy Crush Saga by King is the long-running alternative.

### What games are like Royal Match without in-app purchases?

Look at subscription services rather than free games, because most free match-3 games sell boosters. Apple says its Arcade games have no in-app purchases, and its puzzle list changes, so browse it for a match game you like. Puzzle Jar does sell things (hint packs, take backs, rescues and Remove Ads), so it is not the answer to this exact search; what we can say is that every Bead Swap level is proved winnable with no help, and there are no lives to buy back. Full details are on our free and ads page .

### What games are like Candy Crush?

Candy Crush Saga, made by King, is the best-known swap-and-match game on phones, free to download with purchases on iPhone and Android. In Puzzle Jar, Bead Swap is the closest, played with beads on trays from 7x7 to 9x9. If you like the candy world but want something other than swapping, Fruit Tumble clears groups by tapping. Outside our app, Royal Match and Toon Blast are other well-known names in the same genre.

### What games are like Candy Crush with unlimited lives?

Puzzle Jar has no lives at all, so you can retry a level straight away as often as you like. That applies to Bead Swap, our match-3, and to every other game in the app. Be clear about the trade: levels still have a move limit (15 to 38 moves in Bead Swap), so you can lose a level; you just never wait to try again. Before installing any other match-3, search its store description for "lives" or "energy" to see how it handles retries.

### What games are like Block Blast?

Block Blast!, from Hungry Studio, is the well-known fit-the-pieces-and-clear-lines game. Mosaic Tray uses the same line-clearing on an 8x8 tray, but it is built in levels: you collect jewels with a limited set of pieces dealt in a fixed order, so a level never fails on a bad random hand. If you want endless high-score play, stay with Block Blast; Tetris by PlayStudios is the other famous line-clearer.

### What games are like Block Blast with no ads?

The simplest answer is Block Blast's own Apple Arcade edition: "Block Blast!+" from Hungry Studio is listed on Apple Arcade, and Apple says Arcade games have no ads or in-app purchases. On Android there is no Arcade, so most free block games carry ads. In Puzzle Jar, a single Remove Ads purchase stops the full-screen ads in Mosaic Tray and in our other 19 games together; optional reward videos stay, but only play if you choose them.

### What games are like Tile Busters or Triple Tile?

Tile Busters (Spyke Games) and Triple Tile (Tripledot Studios) are triple tile games: pick uncovered tiles, collect three alike on a bar, and clear the pile. Our Button Tin uses sewing buttons in up to 5 layers and a 7-space card; later hard levels add face-down buttons you must uncover. Tile Explorer by Oakever Games is another popular choice. On their Google Play pages, checked on the US store on 2026-11-24, Tile Busters did not carry the "Contains ads" label, while the others did.

### What games are like Zen Match?

Zen Match, by Moon Active, sells itself on relaxation: triple tile matching with a calm look. If the calm part matters most to you, choose games that do not rush you. Button Tin has no clock and no move limit; a level ends only when the card is full. If you also want no ads at all, an Apple Arcade subscription is the route Apple describes as free of ads and in-app purchases.

### What games are like Goods Sort?

Goods Sort, by Shinrays Games, has you sort small products on shop shelves into groups of three. Shelf Sort is our goods sort: 12 kinds of goods, each with its own outline shape, and locked shelves that open by playing, never by paying or watching an ad. There is no timer and no move count; after 40 moves without a pop, a friendly card asks if you want help.

### What games are like Hexa Sort?

Hexa Sort, published by Lion Studios Plus, is the best-known hexagon stacking game: drop stacks of colored tiles on a honeycomb and watch matching tops hop across and merge. Honey Hive is ours, themed on honey: three stacks are offered at a time, 10 of a color on top are collected toward the level goal, and later levels add iced stacks and locked cells. The stacks you are dealt are fixed for each level rather than random.

### What games are like Bus Jam?

Bus Jam, from Rollic Games, is the crowd-to-bus sorting game: send passengers to the bus of their color without clogging the waiting spots. Bus Out is another well-known one. Hop On is our bus jam. It always shows the buses coming next, uses a bench of 4 to 7 seats, and adds hidden and frozen passengers, doorways and big buses as you go. It has no clock, so you can plan every tap.

### What games are like Unblock Me or Parking Jam?

Unblock Me (Kiragames) is the classic slide-the-blocks-to-free-the-red-one puzzle, and Parking Jam 3D (Popcore) has you drive cars out of a packed lot. Fans like clear logic and the "aha" when one move frees everything. We have two in that spirit. Toy Chest slides colored blocks out through doors of their color. Pencil Case is a tap-away puzzle where pencils leave tip first. Kiragames also sells a paid Premium edition of Unblock Me.

### What games are like Knit Out or Yarn Fever?

Knit Out (Rollic Games) and Yarn Fever (Brave HK) are recent yarn-themed puzzle games. Snug Skeins is ours: felt toys lose a layer of wool with each tap, baskets collect each color, and a small sewing tin holds spare wool. A tap that would overfill the tin is simply refused rather than losing you the level.

### What games are like Twisted Tangle?

Twisted Tangle and Tangle Master 3D, both from Rollic Games, are rope puzzles: move the ends until the knot comes apart. Garland Tangle is our rope untangle, with strings of lights between posts; a string lights up once it crosses nothing, and steel lanterns that cannot move appear later. For a free, ad-free classic, Simon Tatham's Puzzles includes a game called Untangle ( Simon Tatham ).

### What games are like Suika, the watermelon game?

Suika Game, by Aladdin X, is the drop-and-merge game where fruit combines up to a watermelon. On phones it is a paid app, and Apple Arcade also lists "Suika Game+". Treat Drop is our merge drop game with 10 sizes of sweet, from a sprinkle up to a rainbow lolly. The difference: Suika is about the highest score in one long game, while Treat Drop gives you levels with a goal, such as "make 2 tarts", and a set supply of sweets.

### What games are like Bubble Witch 3 Saga?

Bubble Witch 3 Saga (King) and the "Bubble Shooter" apps from Ilyon are the best-known bubble shooters on phones. Fans like aiming bank shots and dropping big clusters at once. Bubble Picnic is ours: a dotted guide shows every bounce and the landing spot, you can swap your next two bubbles for free, and the ceiling never comes down on you. Levels ask you to clear the field or free stars with a set number of bubbles.

### What games are like LinkedIn Queens?

LinkedIn's Queens is a daily logic grid: one queen in every row, column and colored region ( LinkedIn help ). Players often compare it with Star Battle logic puzzles. Quilt Pins is our Star Battle-type game: one pin per patch, row and column, pins never touching, on quilts up to 11x11, and a hint that explains its reasoning. Unlike a once-a-day puzzle, it has a ladder of thousands of quilts. LinkedIn's other daily games, such as Tango and Zip, are in the same place on LinkedIn.

### What games are like Toon Blast?

Toon Blast, by Peak, is a tap-to-blast game: tap groups of matching cubes to clear them and make rockets and bombs. We have three blast games, each with a twist. Fruit Tumble is the classic falling kind. In Balloon Bunch balloons float upward. Tide Pool pushes a new row up every few taps, so you race the tide by moves, not by a clock.

### What games are like Flow Free?

We do not have one, to be honest. Flow Free (Big Duck Games) is a connect-the-colors path puzzle, and Puzzle Jar has no game where you draw lines between dots. If you have Apple Arcade, "Flow Free+" is the same game without ads. Our nearest in feeling is Garland Tangle , which is also about lines that must not cross, though you move lanterns onto posts rather than draw paths. The free Simon Tatham's Puzzles collection has several path and loop puzzles as well.

### What games are like Two Dots?

Two Dots, by Playdots, has you draw lines through dots of the same color to clear them. Puzzle Jar has no line-drawing game, so there is no direct match. If what you enjoy is clearing groups of one color to meet level goals, Fruit Tumble and Balloon Bunch give that feeling with a single tap per group. If it is the drawing itself, look at Flow Free instead.

### What games are like 2048?

2048, the web game by Gabriele Cirulli, merges numbered tiles; Threes! (Sirvo) is a paid sliding-number game with an Apple Arcade edition. Puzzle Jar has no number games, so we are not a fit if numbers are what you like. If it is the merging you enjoy, Treat Drop joins two equal sweets into a bigger one, with no numbers, but with physics and aim instead of sliding a grid.

### What games are like Tetris?

The official Tetris app on phones is published by PlayStudios. Puzzle Jar has no falling-block game and no speed pressure, so it is a different experience. The nearest is Mosaic Tray : you place pieces on a grid and clear rows and columns, but at your own pace, with no clock. For something closer to Tetris itself, stay with the official app.

### What games are like Unpacking or A Little to the Left?

Unpacking (by Witch Beam) and A Little to the Left (Secret Mode) are cozy tidying games: unpack a home, or straighten and sort everyday objects. Unpacking is a paid app, with an Unpacking+ edition on Apple Arcade; A Little to the Left is free to try with a one-time full-game unlock. Puzzle Jar is not a story game like these, but tidying is its heart: Shelf Sort arranges goods on shelves and Sweet Stacks puts sweets in order.

### What games are like pin pull puzzles?

Pin pull games, where you slide out pins to let sand, water or treasure fall the right way, are a separate genre, and Puzzle Jar does not have one. Many people searching "screw pin puzzle" mean screw games instead; if so, Bolts & Jars fits. Be careful with pin-pull ads in general: the UK's Advertising Standards Authority ruled in 2020 that some pin-pull ads for decorating games were misleading because the games were mostly something else ( ASA ).

## Puzzle game types explained

URL: https://sultanofniyyat.github.io/puzzle-jar/puzzle-game-types-explained/

Most phone puzzle games belong to a small set of genres: sorting (screws, nuts, water, goods, yarn), matching (triple tile, match-3), placing (block puzzles, hexa sort), clearing (bus jam, tap-away, tap-to-blast, bubble shooter) and pure logic (Star Battle grids). Below, each genre is explained in plain words, with the Puzzle Jar game that plays it. The second half covers why these games have ads, whether levels are rigged, and what research says, with sources, about puzzles, the brain, stress and sleep.

### What is a screw puzzle game?

A screw puzzle is a board of plates or planks held down by colored screws, and you take the screws out to clear it. Most versions add a rule about where a removed screw goes: into a box, jar or tray of its color, with a small spare space for screws that have nowhere to go yet. The thinking is about order: which screw to free first so the spare space never fills. In our Bolts & Jars , a screw is held in until the plate lying over it is gone.

### What is a nut sort game?

A nut sort game is a stacking puzzle: colored nuts are threaded on upright bolts, and you move the top nuts from bolt to bolt until each bolt holds a single color. You may only drop nuts onto the same color or an empty bolt, so the empty space is what you manage. It is a close cousin of water sort, with metal parts instead of liquid. Our Nut Sort mixes tall bolts that hold 5 with short helper bolts that hold 2 or 3.

### What is a color sort or water sort puzzle?

It is the genre where tubes or jars hold mixed layers of color and you pour or lift the top layer into another container until every container holds one color. A layer can only land on its own color or in an empty container, so you need a free spot to shuffle with. Ball sort is the same idea with balls. In Puzzle Jar this genre is Sweet Stacks , played with sweets in jars, where four alike earn a lid.

### What is a triple tile match game?

A triple tile game deals a pile of picture tiles, some covering others, and a short holding bar underneath. You tap tiles that are not covered; each one moves to the bar, and three matching tiles in the bar disappear. If the bar fills with no three alike, the level ends. It grew out of mahjong-style tile matching, but you match three instead of pairs. Our version, Button Tin , uses buttons in up to 5 layers and a card with 7 spaces.

### What is a match-3 game?

Match-3 is the swap-neighbors genre: you switch two pieces next to each other so that three or more of one color line up and clear, and new pieces drop in from above. Levels usually set goals, such as clearing blockers, within a fixed number of moves. Bigger lines make special pieces that clear rows or areas. Bead Swap is Puzzle Jar's match-3, played with beads, where a swap that makes no line slides back and costs nothing.

### What is a block puzzle game?

In a block puzzle you place shaped pieces on a square grid, and any row or column you complete clears away. Pieces cannot be turned, and the game ends when the pieces you hold no longer fit anywhere. Many block puzzles are endless high-score games with random pieces. Ours, Mosaic Tray , is a level-based kind: an 8x8 tray, a set number of pieces in a fixed order, and jewels you collect by clearing the lines they sit in.

### What is a color block jam puzzle?

It is a sliding-block puzzle where colored blocks fill a walled board and each block can leave only through an exit of its own color. You drag a block in a straight line; it slides until something stops it. The challenge is the order: which blocks to move aside so the right one reaches its door. It is related to classic parking and unblock puzzles. In Toy Chest each drag counts as one move, and later boards add ice, one-way blocks and locks.

### What is a bus jam game?

A bus jam game shows a crowd of colored passengers and a stop where buses of one color arrive in turn. You tap a passenger who has a clear way out; they board the matching bus, or wait on a small bench if their bus is not there yet. A full bench with no one able to board ends the level. Some versions use cars in a parking lot instead. Our Hop On always shows which buses come next and has no clock.

### What is a tap-away puzzle?

A tap-away puzzle fills a board with pieces that each point one way, and tapping a piece sends it sliding out in that direction. If another piece is in its path, it bumps and stays. You clear the board by working out which piece is free first, then which ones that frees. It rewards looking before tapping more than speed. In Pencil Case the pieces are pencils that leave tip first, and each bump costs one of 3 hearts.

### What is a yarn sort or wool game?

Yarn games are a recent family of sorting puzzles built around wool: you unwind balls or knitted figures, and the yarn travels to a spool or basket of its color, with a small waiting area for colors not wanted yet. They play like a screw or bus puzzle with soft materials, and the look of wool unspooling is a big part of the appeal. Snug Skeins is ours: felt toys lose one layer of wool per tap.

### What is a goods sort game?

Goods sort games put small items, such as drinks, snacks or toys, on rows of shelves, and you move them until three of the same item stand side by side and vanish. Items hidden behind the front row move forward as shelves empty, so part of the skill is planning for what you cannot fully see yet. Space is the danger: if every slot fills, you are stuck. Shelf Sort is our goods sort, with 12 kinds of goods that each have their own outline.

### What is a merge drop game?

In a merge drop game you drop round objects into a container from the top; two identical ones that touch join into the next, larger kind. Real physics makes things roll and settle, and you lose if the pile rises over a line at the top. The well-known example uses fruit and ends with a watermelon, so people often call the genre "watermelon games". Treat Drop is a level version: each level asks you to make certain sweets before your supply runs out.

### What is a hexa sort game?

Hexa sort means stacking puzzles played on a honeycomb of six-sided cells. You place small stacks of colored hexagon tiles; when neighbors share a top color, tiles hop from one stack to the other, sometimes in long chains. Once enough of one color pile up together, they clear. Because every cell has six neighbors, one placement can set off many moves, which is the genre's draw. Our hexa sort is Honey Hive , where 10 or more of a color on top are collected.

### What is a tap-to-blast game?

Tap-to-blast (also called collapse or blast games) clears groups instead of lines: you tap two or more touching pieces of one color and the whole group pops. Pieces above fall into the gaps, and large groups leave behind rockets or bombs. Unlike match-3, nothing has to be swapped. Puzzle Jar has three of them: Fruit Tumble (fruit falls down), Balloon Bunch (balloons float up) and Tide Pool , where new rows push up from below every few taps.

### What is a bubble shooter?

A bubble shooter is an aiming game: a field of colored bubbles hangs at the top, and you fire one bubble at a time from the bottom. Hitting a group so that three or more of a color touch pops them, and any bubbles left hanging by nothing drop off. Bouncing shots off the side walls is a core skill. Many older ones push the ceiling down over time. Bubble Picnic , ours, shows the full path of each shot and never lowers the ceiling.

### What is a rope untangle game?

A rope untangle game gives you a knot of ropes or wires pinned between posts, and you move the ends until no rope crosses another. It is a puzzle about crossings, so the trick is spotting which end blocks the most others. The idea is old: free logic collections have long included a version with dots and lines. Our Garland Tangle uses strings of lights; a string glows once it crosses nothing, and each level gives a set number of moves.

### What is a Star Battle puzzle?

Star Battle is a pencil-and-paper logic grid: a square board is split into irregular regions, and you place stars so each row, column and region holds the set number of stars. Well-made grids are meant to be solved by reasoning rather than guessing. LinkedIn's Queens is a one-per-region variant ( LinkedIn help ). Quilt Pins is ours: one pin in every patch, row and column, on quilts from 4x4 to 11x11.

### What counts as a puzzle game?

A puzzle game is one where the main challenge is working something out, such as an order, a placement or a path, rather than reflexes or luck. On phones the label also covers relaxed sorting and matching games that some players would call "casual". A useful test: if a slow, careful player does better than a fast one, it is a puzzle. By that test, 19 of Puzzle Jar's 20 games are pure puzzles; the twentieth, Route Duel , adds a computer rival.

### What are sorting games good for?

Mostly for a calm kind of focus. A sorting game gives you a messy board and one clear goal, so for a few minutes your attention has a simple job and visible progress. They also exercise planning: on hard levels you must think a few moves ahead to keep a free spot. For young children, sorting by color and shape is a familiar early-learning activity, though a phone game is no substitute for real toys. We make no claim beyond that; the research on puzzles is covered further down this page.

### Why are sorting games so satisfying?

Designers usually point to order appearing out of mess, and to small, certain rewards. The makers of the tidying game Unpacking described its core as "the joy of unboxing things", and compared playing it to popping bubble wrap ( Film Stories ). A 2021 study of puzzle players found they kept going when the game met their need to feel capable, in control or connected, and quit easily when it frustrated those needs ( Pusey, Wong and Rappa, Games and Culture ). Claims about "dopamine hits" from sorting are popular but we found no study that tests them.

### What is the difference between hyper-casual and hybrid-casual games?

Both are simple to learn, but they are built and paid for differently. Unity's glossary describes hyper-casual games as quick builds earning mostly from banner and full-screen ads, while hybrid-casual games add a longer progression layer, earn more from purchases and opt-in reward videos, and are "built to engage players for 60-90 days" ( Unity ; Unity sells ad technology, so read it as an industry view). Many sorting puzzles today, Puzzle Jar included, sit in the hybrid group: a level road, helpers and optional videos.

### Why do mobile puzzle games have so many ads?

Because almost all of them are free to download, and ads pay for the free players. On Google Play, AppBrain counts 96.7% of all apps as free ( AppBrain , all apps, not only games). One 2025 industry report put 32.2% of mobile game revenue from in-app ads and 67.8% from purchases ( XMP and Insightrackr, via PocketGamer.biz ). Puzzle games have simple, short levels, which makes a natural pause for an ad. How we handle ads is on our free and ads page .

### Why do mobile game ads look nothing like the game?

Some advertisers show a puzzle or scene that the game barely contains, because it gets more taps. UK regulators have ruled against this: in 2020 the Advertising Standards Authority found pin-pulling ads for two well-known home-decorating games misleading even with a "not all images represent actual gameplay" note ( ASA ruling, 2020 ), and in November 2026 it upheld in part a complaint about a big match-3 game's ad ( ASA ruling, 2026 ). If an ad promises a game, check the store screenshots before you install.

### Are mobile puzzle games rigged?

It depends on the game, and the honest word is "tuned" more than "rigged". Some games deal random pieces, so a run can turn unwinnable through bad luck. Others change difficulty based on how you play: researchers at Electronic Arts published a system that adjusts difficulty to keep players playing longer ( Xue et al., 2017 ). In Puzzle Jar each level is fixed and proved winnable by a solver, but which level you get next does follow how you play, and Route Duel's rival plays stronger or weaker. Details are on our difficulty page .

### What makes a puzzle level fair?

In our view, three things. First, it must be winnable without help; we check every Puzzle Jar level with a computer solver before it ships. Second, what you need to decide should be visible or fairly hinted, such as the next jar or the next bus, so a loss comes from a choice rather than a hidden coin flip. Third, it should play the same on a retry, so you can learn from losing. A level can be very hard and still fair; it is unfair when skill cannot change the result.

### Do brain training games make you smarter?

The evidence says you get better at the games, not at thinking in general. A major 2016 review found "little evidence" that training improves performance on distantly related tasks ( Simons et al., Psychological Science in the Public Interest ), and a 2010 online study in Nature found no transfer to untrained tasks ( Owen et al. ). In 2016 the US Federal Trade Commission made the maker of Lumosity pay $2 million over brain-training claims it said lacked science ( FTC ). Enjoy puzzles for what they are.

### Can puzzle games prevent dementia?

No game has been shown to prevent dementia. The Alzheimer's Society says "there is no strong evidence" that brain training reduces risk ( Alzheimer's Society ). The closest trial result, from the ACTIVE study, involved a specific speed-of-processing training with booster sessions, not puzzle games, and the link was modest ( Coe et al., 2026 ). The 2024 Lancet Commission estimated that about 45% of dementia cases are potentially preventable by tackling 14 risk factors, including hearing loss, physical inactivity, high blood pressure and social isolation ( Livingston et al. ). Those are better places to start.

### Do puzzles keep your memory sharp as you get older?

People who do puzzles often do tend to score better on thinking tests, but that does not prove the puzzles caused it. The PROTECT study of about 19,000 adults aged 50 and over found that "frequency of word puzzle use is directly related to cognitive function" ( Brooker et al., 2019 ), and a companion paper from the same team reported a similar link for number puzzles. The Alzheimer's Society noted such studies "can only show that puzzling and thinking skills are linked" ( Alzheimer's Society ). Puzzles are a pleasant habit, not a proven treatment.

### Can a puzzle game help with stress?

For short spells, some research says it can. In a 2019 study, students waiting for stressful news who played Tetris at a level that absorbed them felt better than those whose game was too easy or too hard ( UC Riverside ). A 2020 review of 13 studies said casual games "may have promise" for stress and low mood ( Pine et al. ), but the studies were small and short. A game is not a treatment; the NHS advises seeing a GP if you are "struggling to cope" with anxiety ( NHS ).

### Is Tetris really used after trauma?

In research, yes, but in a specific way. In a trial published in 2017, people in a hospital emergency department after a car crash recalled the event and then played about 20 minutes of Tetris; they had fewer intrusive memories in the first week, but the trial did not show wider benefits at one month ( Iyadurai et al., Molecular Psychiatry ). An earlier lab study found a similar drop in flashbacks ( Holmes et al., 2009 ). The authors called for larger trials. It is a research method with a set routine, not a reason to self-treat with any game.

### Do puzzle games help you sleep?

There is no good evidence that they do, and screens before bed are usually advised against. The NHS insomnia advice says not to use devices "like smartphones, right before going to bed" ( NHS ), and the American Academy of Sleep Medicine suggests powering down electronics 30 to 60 minutes before bed ( AASM, 2026 ). If you do play in the evening, a game with no clock and no "one more life" countdown is easier to put down; ours has Reduce motion and sound switches in Settings.

### Are "win real money" sort and tile games legit?

Be careful with them. Some are real skill-gaming apps with published rules, and many others are ordinary puzzle games whose ads promise cash that is hard or impossible to collect. Before you spend time or money, read the payout terms, check whether you must deposit money to "cash out", and read the low-star reviews, which is where payout problems show up. Puzzle Jar does not pay money or prizes of any kind; there is nothing to cash out, and nothing in the game is worth real money.

## About Puzzle Jar and the people who make it

URL: https://sultanofniyyat.github.io/puzzle-jar/about/

Puzzle Jar is made by Sultan of Niyyat, a small independent studio. We design the games, build the levels and test them ourselves, and we answer the support email ourselves too. This page explains how we work, why the app looks the way it does, and how to reach us at sultanofniyyat@gmail.com.

### Who makes Puzzle Jar?

Sultan of Niyyat, a small independent studio and the only company behind the app. Every one of the 20 games is our own design: its name, its rules, its pieces and its levels. The genres are well known, screw puzzles, nut sorts, bubble shooters and so on, but nothing in Puzzle Jar is licensed from or made with another game company. The picture outlines in Route Duel come from Google's free Noto Emoji set, which we credit in Settings.

### Why did you put 20 games in one app?

Because the most common complaint about single-genre puzzle apps, in the reviews we read, is that the same rule gets repetitive after a while. A collection lets the puzzle change every three levels while your helpers, your jar and your streak stay in one place. Reviews of other game collections also praise having many games without filling up the phone, and we liked the idea of one download, one Remove Ads purchase and one set of settings.

### Why was Puzzle Jar called Route Duel before?

Route Duel was our first game: a duel against a computer rival on picture boards, released in October 2026. In November we decided the app should hold several completely different puzzle games, each with its own look, and a duel-only name no longer fitted, so we picked one that suits a collection. That became update 2.0.0 on the same store pages, so nobody had to download anything new or lose their progress. Route Duel itself is still inside, as the last game on the road.

### How do you test that every level can be won?

A computer solver plays each level before it ships, with no hints, no take backs and no rescues, and a level that the solver cannot finish is thrown away. Then about 400 simulated "casual" players, which mostly make sensible moves and sometimes careless ones, play it too, and we record how many of them get stuck. Automatic tests check every shipped level again before each release, so a rule change cannot quietly break an old level.

### How do you decide how hard a level is?

By that stuck rate rather than by feel. Levels come in rounds of easy, medium and hard, with a boss on every fourth hard level and an easy breather straight after each hard one, and each kind must land in its own band of stuck players. The game also adjusts to you, a step harder after easy wins and a step easier after a struggle. The full detail, with the numbers, is on our page about difficulty and getting stuck .

### How did you decide where the ads go?

We started from what puzzle players complain about most in store reviews, which is ads, and chose the gentlest setup that still keeps the app free: no banners, nothing during a level, no ad until you have finished three levels, and a 5-second notice with a Remove Ads button before each one. Videos that give extra help only play when you tap them. Prices and exactly what Remove Ads changes are on the page about cost and ads .

### How did you choose the games in Puzzle Jar?

We looked for genres that millions of people already enjoy on their phones and that stay calm: sorting, tile matching, block puzzles, jams, merges, blasts, a bubble shooter and a logic grid. Then we kept only games played with shapes and colors. We decided against card, word and number games, so there is no solitaire, no word search and no sudoku. A few early games were later replaced because we liked them less than the rest and their genres were less popular.

### Is Puzzle Jar designed for color-blind players?

Yes, as far as we could manage. In the sorting and matching games every color also carries its own symbol, such as a heart, a shield, a star, a tick, a bolt or an eye, and within a game the same color always has the same symbol, so you can play by shape alone. Other games give each kind of piece its own outline or picture, such as the twelve goods in Shelf Sort or the six fruits in Fruit Tumble.

### How can I contact the Puzzle Jar team?

Email us at sultanofniyyat@gmail.com, or use the support page at https://sultanofniyyat.github.io/route-duel-privacy/support/. We read every message ourselves; there is no outside support company and no chatbot. Please include the game and level number if your question is about a level.

### How do I report a bug or suggest a new game?

Send an email to sultanofniyyat@gmail.com. For a bug, tell us the game, the level number, your phone model and the app version, which you can find at the bottom of Settings; a screenshot helps a lot. For a game idea, name the kind of puzzle and what you like about it. Every bug report goes into our numbered bug log, where it stays until it is fixed and checked.

### Who wrote this website?

We did, with help from an AI writing assistant. We gave it the real rules, numbers and code of the game, and then checked every answer against the app and its code before publishing. If you find anything here that does not match what you see in Puzzle Jar, please email sultanofniyyat@gmail.com and we will fix the page.

### Is Puzzle Jar connected to the other puzzle games named on this site?

No. Where we mention other games or genres, it is only to explain what kind of puzzle one of ours is, for readers who already know that style. We have no partnership with any other game maker, none of them made or approved Puzzle Jar, and their names belong to their owners.

### Where can I get screenshots and facts about Puzzle Jar for an article?

Start with this website: each game page has a real screenshot from the app and the rules in plain words. The home page has a short facts table with price, platforms, size and age rating. If you need bigger images, a short description of a game or an answer to a specific question, email sultanofniyyat@gmail.com and tell us where it will appear.
